turns.text: Hello [NAME] आपको old and used forklift की requirement है ना?
Okay. Can you speak in English, Madam?
Sure, I can speak in English. Just to confirm, you are interested in old and used forklift, right?
Okay take your time. I'm here whenever you are ready.
What is the cost of this vehicle madam?
You can discuss the price directly with the seller. I will connect you with the best sellers. Just need to confirm a few more details first.
Great, could you please tell me which capacity you prefer, 210 or something else?
Actually I have seen your ad is quoted and used for lift 2 ton side loaded 150000 price.
Thank you for sharing. Just to confirm, do you need a 210 capacity or a different one? Please specify your preference.
No no no that's enough two tons is enough and I am ready to this price.
Perfect. And which fuel type do you prefer diesel, electric or LPG?
Noted. I will send you seller details on WhatsApp so you can discuss all details and price directly. Thank you for choosing IndiaMART. Have a great day.
